tools.name: inspect_url
tools.description: Free, lightweight check of a public URL: reachability, HTTP status, final URL after redirects, content type, page title, and whether extraction is likely to work. Downloads at most a small prefix of the page.

tools.name: extract_url
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return its main content as clean Markdown with title, description, headings and extraction metadata. Removes navigation, ads, cookie banners and scripts. Does not execute JavaScript. Paid via x402 ($0.003 per successful call; the first 5 successful calls per day are free)

tools.name: extract_url_structured
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return structured data: page metadata (title, description, canonical URL, language, site name, byline), main content Markdown, ordered headings with levels, and links (text + URL). findings.detail: Description of "extract_url" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
